title: Amazingly Aromatic Brazilian Beef Roast
description: This indulgent Brazilian dish features a tender beef roast served with a tangy gherkin relish, making for a truly unforgettable meal. The combination of yeasty and springy flavors creates a unique taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef roast with sea salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium high heat.
Sear the beef roast on all sides until browned.
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the yeast extract and stir to combine.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast for 2 hours.
While the roast is cooking, prepare the gherkin relish according to the package instructions.
Once the roast is cooked, let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving with the gherkin relish and chopped parsley.
